payload.name: Proximate microcelebrification
payload.fact: Micro-microcelebrities inherit celebrity status through the preemptive and continuous exposure provided by their Influencer mothers, often beginning during the pre-birth pregnancy stage.
payload.boundary: Children of Influencers (under 4 years old) in Singapore.
